snippet.title: Primal Planet - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Enjoy the new gameplay launch trailer for Primal Planet, the primeval pixel-art survival metroidvania that hits PC on July 28. Check it out on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350270/Primal_Planet/
